bullets.text: In Periyapalayam, public protested by blocking the Chennai-Tirupati road due to a five-hour power outage, and the office should monitor local electricity supply.
In Thiruvallur, a crack on the Arani river bridge caused shock, and the office should watch for repair updates from the district administration.
In Avadi, a mother and her partner were arrested for sexually harassing a 15-year-old girl, and the office should track police action.
In Thiruvallur, Diwali firecracker injuries caused 81 people to lose vision, and the office should review safety awareness campaigns.
In Gummidipoondi, the fire and rescue department held a fire-free Diwali awareness event, and the office should track community safety programs.
In Chennai, ELCOT and IITM Pravartak signed an MoU at the Secretariat for a state AI data centre, and the office should monitor project rollout.
Globally, LiveX and NVIDIA launched AI City at the Smart City Expo to bring physical AI to airports and hospitals, and the portfolio team should review adoption.
Across India, the data center boom offers a massive lending opportunity for banks, and the portfolio team should watch infrastructure growth.
